knowledge:
- key_parameters: Eset.data=An ExpressionSet object containing normalized log-intensity expression data and phenotype data ;; comp.var=The name or numeric index of the column in the phenotype data containing the group labels ;; comp.def=A string defining the contrast for the two-group comparison (e.g., "tumor-control") ;; gset.collection=A GeneSetCollection object defining gene-sets for the differential expression analysis ;; map.data=A list containing probe.map (a data.frame mapping probe IDs between experiments), map.Aprobe.col (index/name of experiment A probe column), and map.Bprobe.col (index/name of experiment B probe column) ;; min.nperms=Minimum number of permutations for adaptive permutation testing ;; max.nperms=Maximum number of permutations for adaptive permutation testing
- alternatives: Classical permutation test (can be performed by setting min.nperms = max.nperms)
- when_to_use: When comparing two-group differential expression results across two different experiments, platforms, or species (e.g., matching a mouse model of a disease to human disease subtypes) to evaluate transcriptome-wide or gene-set level agreement.
- pitfalls: Ensure that the expression data and phenotype data have samples in the exact same order (rownames of pData must match colnames of exprs) ;; The call to agdex and the map.data object must label the experiments (A and B) in the same way ;; Real applications require larger values of min.nperms and max.nperms than the small values used in the package examples.

workflows.name: cross_species_differential_expression_agreement
workflows.intent: Evaluate the agreement of differential expression profiles across two experiments (e.g., human and mouse) at both the genome-wide and gene-set levels.
input: map.data (List mapping probe IDs between experiment A and B)
workflows.stages: 1. Create dex.set objects for each experiment using make.dex.set.object ;; 2. Run the AGDEX analysis using agdex ;; 3. Visualize results using agdex.scatterplot ;; 4. Extract gene-set details using get.gset.result.details
workflows.code:
dex.set.human <- make.dex.set.object(Eset.data= human.data,                            
                                     comp.var=2,                                       
                                     comp.def="human.tumor.typeD-other.human.tumors",  
                                     gset.collection=gset.data)                        
dex.set.mouse <- make.dex.set.object(mouse.data,
                                     comp.var=2,
                                     comp.def="mouse.tumor-mouse.control",
                                     gset.collection=NULL)                                      
agdex.res<-agdex(dex.setA=dex.set.human,
                 dex.setB=dex.set.mouse,
                 map.data=map.data,
                 min.nperms=5,
                 max.nperms=10)
agdex.scatterplot(agdex.res, gset.id=NULL)
gset.res.stats<-get.gset.result.details(agdex.res, gset.ids = NULL, alpha=0.01)
dna.cat.process.gset.res<-get.gset.result.details(agdex.res, gset.ids="DNA_CATABOLIC_PROCESS")
